where: js/stations/graph4d.js
problem: request from i1-station-lab: (owner i1-station-branches-graph4d, optional for iteration 2) lift the 'cartGrid' spec kind too (cartGrid({ xRange, yRange, step, n: 96 })); it currently ignores it. Every other Lab spec kind is already read.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: js/stations/roots.js, zLayer: drawPolarAddress(roots[j], { ghosts: 1, ghostsNeg: ... }). Evidence: docs/review/iter-1/i1-station-roots-principal/reviewA/p2/r-z-m1i-7-k3-1280.png and r-z-dec5-1280.png, plus the phone versions r-z-*-390.png.
problem: [minor] The selected root's 'Arg z_k = ...' / 'also ...' block is placed by the plane's label placer, which cannot see the axes, tick labels, circle or n-gon edges. In crowded states it lands far from the selected root, on the opposite side of the origin from its arc. At c = -1 + i, n = 7, k = 3 the real axis runs through the middle of 'Arg z3 = 3.029', so it reads as '= -3.029' (wrong sign) and sits on the 0.5 tick label. Even for 1.4.2 k = 0 the block straddles the circle and the dotted n-gon edge, and in the 1.4.2 k = 2 view the ray touches the 'k = 2' label. The text stays legible thanks to the halo, and the headline presets (c = 1, n = 5 and c = -16, n = 4, all k) are acceptable. The pick note and list line below give the correct Arg.
fix: Take up the optional plane.js request (a registerObstacle for axes, ticks, circle and n-gon segments). Or have the station draw its own Arg label next to the arc end. Until then, the sign-misread case could be avoided by never letting the block sit on y = 0.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: js/stations/principal-root.js layer and handles. Evidence: reviewA/p4/m1cube-1280.png, zero-1280.png and reviewA/p6/end-1280.png.
problem: [minor] Three collisions on the principal-root plane. (1) The designed preset 'w = -1, n = 3' puts w exactly on its real cube root, which is selected by default (step 1). The 'w' and 'k = 1' labels overprint into one unreadable blob, and the ring sits on w, so the 'real root is not the principal one' picture the trap note describes cannot be seen. (2) At w = 0 the '0: every root' label overprints the w handle and its label. (3) When w is near its principal root (for example the end of a sweep, w about 1.97 - 0.34i) the 'angle Arg w / n = ...' label is half hidden under w's ring. The 'r = 2' label also sits on the '1' tick at w = 2i.
fix: Offset the ghost root's label when it coincides with w, and draw the w = 0 label away from the handle. Consider placing the principal 'angle ...' label on the side away from w.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: js/stations/roots.js eq row (thetaTex line) and js/stations/roots.js quadratic plane / raise spiral.
problem: [minor] The polar 'equation' cell prints 'k = 0, 1, ..., ${n-1}', which reads 'k = 0, 1, ..., 1' for n = 2 and 'k = 0, 1, ..., 2' for n = 3. These are the c = 2i chip, the quadratic big-picture state and the c = i chip. This matches the design text literally but looks odd. In addition, the quadratic plane's 'slide by 2' label sits on the dashed arrow and circle, and the raise spiral's 'z^4 = c' label overprints the 'c' handle label.
fix: For n <= 3 write the list out ('k = 0, 1' and 'k = 0, 1, 2'). Move the 'slide by h' label off the arrow, and offset 'z^n = c' from the handle.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: js/stations/roots.js mountSlot / NEUTRAL_TEXT; visible on #problem-1-4-3 (reviewA/smoke/problem-1-4-3--desktop.png).
problem: [minor] Because the slot reserves the height of the tallest callout, a neutral one-line 'Your own numbers.' callout leaves roughly 60 to 100 px of blank space under it. On the 1.4.3 deep link the neutral callout sits between the quadratic panel and the controls and tells the student the numbers match no review problem, although c = -9 was set by the quadratic panel just above. It is a harmless but slightly confusing line.
fix: Optionally give the neutral callout the same min-height styling without the extra space, or on the 1.4.3 deep link word the neutral line as 'c = d from the quadratic above'.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: js/stations/roots.js and js/stations/principal-root.js tagStairRows.
problem: [minor] The 'k = n' tags are injected by querying the shared staircase widget's internal markup (li[data-k] > .stair-row). If that widget's markup changes, the tags disappear silently with no error. The tags currently survive updates, seam crossings and n changes (checked), so this is a maintenance risk only.
fix: Keep the existing request to add a showK option to createStaircase, then delete the station-side injection.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: js/stations/roots.js setNumber / onCField (and the same in principal-root.js).
problem: [minor] The 'That is a big number. Keeping |c| at 100 or less' message disappears as soon as the student moves to the other field. The clamped value is written back to the first field on change, so the next input event re-reads an in-range value and clears the message. The field is still corrected, so this is cosmetic.
fix: Keep the message until the next edit that actually changes the clamped value, or until blur.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: js/stations/roots.js, quadratic panel (#roots-quadratic, ids roots-qex-*) with typed decimal coefficients
problem: [minor] The house-style fix (exact only for whole-number input) was applied to the roots and principal-root explainers but not to the quadratic panel. For a = 0.5, b = -3.7, c = 12.25 the cells show '(-37/10)^2 - 4(1/2)(49/4) = -10.81' and 'z = 37/10 + 3.288i' (fractions beside decimals). The values are correct. The review problem 1.4.3 uses whole numbers and is unaffected.
fix: Give quadraticModel an 'exact' flag (all of a, b, c whole numbers) and print typed decimals as decimals in the roots-qex-* cells, as roots and principal-root already do.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: 1.4.3 panel, row 'same point', polar column (roots-qex-same-polar)
problem: [minor] The polar column of the check row shows a Cartesian substitution of the second root, '(1)(2 - 3i)^2 + (-4)(2 - 3i) + 13 = 0', instead of a polar form. The two columns check different roots rather than the same point written two ways, so the two-address teaching is weaker there.
fix: Show the polar form of the root, for example (2 + 3 e^{i pi/2}) substituted, or label the row 'both roots check'.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: roots plane label placement (roots, problem-1-4-2)
problem: [minor] Overlaps remain. At 390 px the 'also -7pi/4' line of the Arg block is crossed by the k = 2 ray. At n = 12, c = 0.3 - 0.7i the 'r = 0.978' label is clipped by the plane edge and the 'x = 0.973' label overlaps '0, 12'. The builder already noted that the label placer cannot see the n-gon edges and circle. Text stays legible because of the halo.
fix: Optional, for a later iteration. Let plane.js export an obstacle registration so stations can register their rays, circle and n-gon edges, or drop the r label when n is large.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: principal-root, far-w state (w = 40, n = 6, whole plane shown)
problem: [minor] The root dots and their labels pile up at the origin ('k=2 1', 'principal', 'k=4 5' overlap) until the student presses 'Zoom in on the roots'. In the roots-only view the off-screen w's 'x = 40' and 'r = 40' labels still draw at the plane edge, which is slightly noisy.
fix: Optional: hide the k labels of ghost roots when the roots are closer than about 12 px, and skip w's address labels in the roots-only view.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: principal-root explainer, 'same point' polar cell for negative Arg
problem: [minor] A negative angle prints as 'e^{i -2.214}' (for example '(2.236)^2 e^{i -2.214}') while other cells print 'e^{-i 2.214}'. The value is right; the typography is inconsistent. In the roots explainer for n = 2, 'k = 0, 1, ..., 1' reads oddly.
fix: Use the same negative-angle TeX helper for the same-point cell, and print 'k = 0, 1' when n = 2.

where: i1-station-roots-principal: principal-root default state (ARCHITECTURE 9 / design 7.1)
problem: [minor] The station mounts with the non-principal ghost root (k = 1) selected, so the first pick note a student reads on problem 2.2.2 is 'It is a root of w, but it is not the principal root'. This follows the design doc. The readout and the 'same point' row still show 1 + i, so the answer is clear, but a student who came only for the principal value meets the ghost root first.
fix: Optional: default sel to 0 and let the student click the ghost root, or keep it deliberately and note it in the design doc.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: branches w-plane, after a jumping walk on the principal seam (reviewA/br-jump-planes-L/D/P.png)
problem: [minor] The label 'r = 1.038' still touches the dashed jump chord. The build report discloses this: plane.js cannot register a drawn segment as an obstacle for its address labels.
fix: Request open on js/core/plane.js: a { register: true } option on drawSegment, or an exported registerObstacle(ctx, a, b). Then pass it for the chord in drawW.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: branches walk detail copy and 5.A.7, principal seam with 'Walk along the negative real axis'
problem: [minor] The status says 'continuous' with the generic sentence 'The value moves smoothly'. Nothing on screen says why, namely that every sample has Arg = pi, the closed end of the window. A student can read this as 'the principal branch is continuous on the negative axis', which is the wrong answer to 2.4.1. The design explains it only in the design document, not on the page.
fix: For kind 'along' when negAxisStatus(seam) is 'edge', add a sentence to the detail: 'Every point of this walk sits on the closed end of the window, so it never meets the jump. Walk across to test the cut.'

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: Staircase caption on branches: 'It is Arg z only when the window is (-pi, pi].'
problem: [minor] Taken literally it is false for many points. At seam 0 and z = -1 + 0.5i the readout shows chosen theta = 2.678 and Arg z = 2.678, which are equal while the window is (0, 2pi]. The intended meaning is that the step is named Arg z only for the principal window, but the sentence reads as a claim about values.
fix: Reword, for example: 'With the window (-pi, pi] this step is always Arg z. With any other window it is Arg z only for some points of the plane.'

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: readoutText / polarText for positive real values (for example z = 1 at seam -pi, z = 8)
problem: [minor] The readout prints the value twice: 'z^(1/3) on this branch = 1 = 1'. polarText drops the angle when it is 0 and fmtCart prints the same number. It follows design T9 literally but looks like a typo.
fix: In readoutText, skip the ' = <cart>' part when the polar text equals the Cartesian text.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: Staircase at z = 0 on branches (reviewA/br-z0-stairs-viewport.png)
problem: [minor] The widget shows 'Arg z = undefined' directly under 'arg z is not defined here'. The text comes from js/core/staircase.js, not this goal.
fix: Fold into Appendix C request 1 for staircase.js: at z = 0 hide the Arg line or say 'no angle'.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: branches.js nameTheSet() (called on every refresh)
problem: [minor] The station rewrites DOM text inside the staircase widget (set line, crossing note, z = 0 sentence, list aria-label) after each update. This is fragile coupling to widget copy and it stays until staircase.js gets homeLabel. It works in every state I tried: seams -pi, -pi/2, 2.9 and pi, and z = 0.
fix: Keep as is for now. When staircase.js lands homeLabel (priority request 1), delete nameTheSet() and pass label 'arg z' with homeLabel.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: graph4d explainer 'w = f(z)' polar cell for the root presets at exactly z = 0
problem: [minor] It prints 'phi = Arg z / 3 = 0' while the row above says theta is undefined at r = 0. The value is harmless (w = 0) but the label names an Arg that does not exist.
fix: At r < 1e-9, drop the 'Arg z / n =' prefix and print 'phi = 0'.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: graph4d strokes panel copy (design 2.2.5)
problem: [minor] For one shape the text reads 'The Lab has 1 shape. They are drawn on the graph...'. The plural 'They' does not agree.
fix: Use 'It is drawn' when N = 1 and nothing is left out, and update the design copy and unit test G9c.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: graph4d layout at 768 to 1440 px (reviewA/g4-sq-L.png; widths test)
problem: [minor] #graph4d-view is square at every width. At 768 to 1024 px it is 660 to 700 px tall, so the controls fall below the fold. At 1280 px the left column has an empty area under the 434 px view while the controls column runs to about 700 px.
fix: Optional: cap the square size to min(100%, 520px), or use 4:3 below 1060 px and square above.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: branches 3D surface on a phone (reviewA/p241-surface-P.png)
problem: [minor] The surface fills about 240 px of its 324 px square view and the beads are 5.5 to 7 px, so the three roots are small. They are legible but tight.
fix: Optional: on viewports of 600 px and narrower, fit with padding 1.0, or raise the bead pixel radii a little.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: Spec A2 text: "readout has 0.5 - 0.8" at z = -1 - 0.05i on the principal seam
problem: [minor] The literal substring cannot appear. The readout correctly says "e^(-i 1.031) = 0.515 - 0.858i". My independent value is 0.5146 - 0.8579i. This is shorthand in the spec, not a defect in the delivery.
fix: Reword the spec to the regex /0\.5\d* - 0\.8\d*i/ or "0.515 - 0.858i". Nothing to change in the code.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: js/stations/graph4d.js lines 354-355: the note under the sqrt-all and cbrt-all presets
problem: [minor] The copy says "At uv = 0 ... Set uv to 90 degrees: the sheets stack like a spiral staircase", but clicking the preset already sets uv to 90 degrees. The student reads an instruction the view has already carried out.
fix: Reword, for example "This preset starts at uv = 90 degrees, where the sheets stack like a spiral staircase. Drag uv back to 0 and two of them cross along the negative real axis."

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: branches w-plane after a jumping walk on the principal seam
problem: [minor] The "r = 1.038" label still touches the dotted jump chord. This is the open wart the builder reported, and it has no effect on correctness.
fix: Needs a js/core/plane.js request, so that a station can register a drawn segment as an obstacle for its address labels. It is already in requests_for_other_owners.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: graph4d recip preset
problem: [minor] The 1/z surface is small in its square view, because the 4-norm bound is large. It is still readable, and the bead and probe are visible.
fix: Optional: a hiddenScale or tighter clamp for the recip preset, as proposed in the build report.

where: i1-station-branches-graph4d: branches staircase widget (core/staircase.js)
problem: [minor] The station still works around the missing homeLabel option with nameTheSet(). The visible result is correct: the set line always says "arg z = {...}", the home row says "chosen θ" or "Arg z", and at z = 0 it says "arg z is not defined here". The workaround is code debt, not a user-facing problem.
fix: Add homeLabel to js/core/staircase.js (request 1, still open), then drop nameTheSet() from branches.js.
